exportMetadata.note: Review state for the operational guidance in data/forms-catalog.json: purpose, maker, threshold, clock, authority boundaries, traps, pre-use checks and safety pearl. Every entry here is drafted from the Act text and the approved form and carries no clinician sign-off, so the Forms UI labels it 'Awaiting clinical review'. A named reviewer records sign-off by setting status to 'reviewed' with reviewedBy and reviewedAt. Section summaries are reviewed separately in data/forms-act-section-cues.json and data/mha-2014-sections.json.

Drafted from Mental Health Act 2014 (WA) s 41, s 42 with s 26, s 36 as context, and from the approved Form 1A attachment as listed on the Office of the Chief Psychiatrist register. Section basis: The attachment carries referral information given in confidence by someone other than the person. s 41(c) and (d) require the referral to set out the information the suspicion rests on and to distinguish its source; s 42(2) is the exception that keeps information supplied on condition of non-disclosure from the person.
